summary: Practise Excel-based financial forecasting, driver analysis, backtesting, and scenario reporting. Explore the five-day course and its practical outline.
lede: Financial data analytics and forecasting helps finance professionals turn reconciled ledger, budget, and operational data into traceable forecasts. For FP&A professionals, analysts, and finance managers, the course addresses the practical work of explaining forecast movements and refreshing forecasts. You practise Excel-based reconciliation and driver models, cash-flow and working-capital schedules, forecast backtesting with error metrics, and scenario and variance reporting; time-series methods such as smoothing and ARIMA receive an applied introduction.
audienceIntro: This course suits finance professionals who work with budgets, actuals, business drivers, and forecasts and need to make their analysis easier to refresh and explain.
modules: Cash Flow and Working Capital Models
prerequisites: Working knowledge of financial statements, budgeting, and Excel formulas is expected. Coding or programming is not required. Advanced time-series and Monte Carlo topics receive conceptual or operational treatment, while spreadsheet reconciliation, driver modelling, and forecast evaluation receive hands-on practice.
